title: rosa subcinerea var. tomentella
intro: Rosa subcinerea var. tomentella, commonly known as Himalayan rose or wild rose, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Himalayan rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral effects. The therapeutic actions of Himalayan rose are thought to be due to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
